mapper.sql: id, user_id, title, summary, category, tags, pinned, views, version, content_hash, visibility, deleted, deleted_at, created_at, updated_at

n.id, n.user_id, n.title, n.summary, n.category, n.tags, n.pinned, n.views, n.version, n.content_hash, n.visibility, n.deleted, n.deleted_at, n.created_at, n.updated_at, u.id AS author_id, COALESCE(u.nickname, u.username) AS author_name
mapper.select:
SELECT FROM note n LEFT JOIN user u ON n.user_id = u.id WHERE n.deleted = 0 AND n.visibility = 1
AND n.category = #{category}
AND MATCH(n.title, n.summary) AGAINST (#{keyword} IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE)
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM note_tag_rel r JOIN tag t ON r.tag_id = t.id WHERE r.note_id = n.id AND t.name = #{tag} )
ORDER BY n.pinned DESC, n.updated_at DESC

SELECT n.id, n.user_id, n.title, n.summary, n.category, n.tags, n.pinned, n.views, n.version, n.content_hash, n.visibility, n.deleted, n.deleted_at, n.created_at, n.updated_at, (MATCH(n.title, n.summary) AGAINST (#{keyword} IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) * 3 + MATCH(c.content) AGAINST (#{keyword} IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE)) AS score FROM note n JOIN note_content c ON c.note_id = n.id WHERE n.user_id = #{userId} AND n.deleted = 0 AND (MATCH(n.title, n.summary) AGAINST (#{keyword} IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE) OR MATCH(c.content) AGAINST (#{keyword} IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE)) ORDER BY score DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT n.id, n.user_id, n.title, n.summary, n.category, n.tags, n.pinned, n.views, n.version, n.content_hash, n.visibility, n.deleted, n.deleted_at, n.created_at, n.updated_at, 0 AS score FROM note n JOIN note_content c ON c.note_id = n.id WHERE n.user_id = #{userId} AND n.deleted = 0 AND (n.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR n.summary LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR c.content LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')) ORDER BY n.updated_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT FROM note n LEFT JOIN user u ON n.user_id = u.id WHERE n.id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO note (id, user_id, title, summary, category, tags, pinned, views, version, content_hash, visibility, deleted, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{userId}, #{title}, #{summary}, #{category}, #{tags}, #{pinned}, #{views}, #{version}, #{contentHash}, #{visibility}, #{deleted}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE note SET title = #{title}, summary = #{summary}, category = #{category}, tags = #{tags}, content_hash = #{contentHash}, visibility = #{visibility}, version = version + 1, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id} AND version = #{version}
UPDATE note SET visibility = #{visibility}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId} AND deleted = 0
UPDATE note SET deleted = 1, deleted_at = #{deletedAt} WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
UPDATE note SET views = views + 1 WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE note SET pinned = #{pinned}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{noteId} AND user_id = #{userId}
